title: 30th September - Youth Month Program - Quiz
summary: 30th September – Quiz in English at SL & SS Girls High School, Thakurdwar.
description:
30th September – Quiz in English at SL & SS Girls High School, Thakurdwar.
Day 3 of our Youth Month celebrations brought 145 enthusiastic students from 14 schools together for a lively and stimulating Quiz Competition. The wonderful response from the schools and the sheer number of young participants made the day meaningful. With the question papers available in English, Hindi and Marathi, and 4 multiple-choice options for every question, the children had an opportunity to test their knowledge, think quickly and, most importantly, enjoy the spirit of learning. Every participant was given a fruit and a drink.
A big kudos to Project Directors Rtn. Shiv Prasad Khator and Rtn. Navnath Panaskar for their commitment and meticulous efforts in making Youth Month enriching for participants. Biscuits and frooti were distributed.
Because every good question opens the door to a new thought—and every curious mind is a future waiting to unfold.
Beneficiaries 145 students. Project cost Rs 15,000/-
